identity.name: Tetterode complex, former Lettergieterij 'Amsterdam' v/h N. Tetterode
identity.addresses: Bilderdijkstraat 155-167 and Da Costakade 136-164 (71 verblijfsobjecten in one BAG pand)
identity.parts: corner house Bilderdijkstraat 155-157; melkfabriek Holland 1898 (rijksmonument 524830); factory 1902-03 by J.W.F. Hartkamp (524828); Da Costakade extension 1909-12 by Hartkamp (524831); block 1940-51 by Merkelbach & Karsten; housing Da Costakade 136-140 after the 1980s squat
identity.correctionsToBrief: the ochre workshop front faces the Bilderdijkstraat (W 248), not the Da Costakade; the lettered band is on both fronts; the red-brick range with balconies is the 1898 dairy; the glass block's curve is panorama projection, its real half-round is the roof volume

frame.axes: e from the Bilderdijkstraat front (0) to the Da Costakade front (~60.3), n north (0) to south (70.57); E=(0.92397,-0.38246), N=(0.38246,0.92397) in native x east / z south; origin BAG vertex 13 (-48.26, -4.023); A(e,n) in da-costakade-146-builder.ts

partyWallEvidence: South (157.5): the factory and the 1909 tower adjoin the Bilderdijkstraat/Da Costakade houses to the south; north (337.5): the corner house and the housing block's north end adjoin neighbouring pands. Not photographed; drawn plain.
